Rashi on Megillah 6a:10:1.hebrew: לדידי חזי לי זבת חלב ודבש דכל ארץ ישראל - בכל מקום שהוא שם, ואם באת לצרפו יחד, הוי כמבי כובי עד אקרא דתולבקני — שם מקום:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:10:1.english: I myself have seen [the land] flowing with milk and honey of all of Eretz Yisrael - [It is found] in every place where it is there; and if you come to combine it together, it is like [the distance from] Bei Kovei to Akra deTulbakni — [the] name of a place.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:10:2.hebrew: אקרא - מקום מעבר הנהר, ובלע"ז פורט"ו:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:10:2.english: Akra - A place of crossing the river, and in Old French, porto.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:11:1.english: Preferable to him - [They were] dearer to him.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:12:1.english: A stake driven in - For harm.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:12:2.english: The captured tower of Shir - The conquered tower of Shir.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:13:1.hebrew: והסירותי דמיו מפיו וגו' - גבי צור כתיב, שהוא ראש לאדום:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:13:1.english: “And I will take away his blood out of his mouth,” etc. - It is written regarding Tyre, which is the head of Edom.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:13:2.hebrew: גלייא במיא - ראשי ע"ז הם לאדום:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:13:2.english: Galyā [and] bāmayā - They are the chief [centers of] idol worship belonging to Edom.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:14:1.english: As a Jebusite - That is Jerusalem.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:14:2.english: And Edom shall be for the chiefs of Judah - And Ekron will be [like] a house of study in Jerusalem.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:15:1.english: Leshem - A city that the children of Dan conquered.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:15:2.hebrew: זו פמייס - שמשם ירדן יוצא, כדאמר מר: ״ירדן יוצא ממערת פמייס״ (בכורות דף נה.):
Rashi on Megillah 6a:15:2.english: This is Pamyas - For from there the Jordan emerges, as the Master said: “The Jordan emerges from the cave of Pamyas” (Bekhorot 55a).

Rashi on Megillah 6a:15:3.hebrew: מטרופולין - לשון יון: אימא של מלכות. מטר"א — אם, פולין — לשון שררה, כדאמר מר: ״עד שבאו דיופלי מהעיר״ — שני שרים (תענית דף יח:):
Rashi on Megillah 6a:15:3.english: Metropolis - [In] the Greek language, [this means] a mother [city] of royalty: matra [means] mother, [and] polin is an expression of rulership, as the Master said: “Until dyopoli came from the city” — [meaning] two ministers (Ta’anit 18b).

Rashi on Megillah 6a:15:4.english: That they raise - That they would raise the sons of kings there.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:16:1.hebrew: אמלאה החרבה - רישא דקרא: "יען אמרה צור על ירושלים אמלאה החרבה" — עכשיו אתמלא מחורבתה:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:16:1.english: I shall be filled with her that is laid waste - The beginning of the verse [is]: “Because Tyre has said against Jerusalem... ‘I shall be filled with her that is laid waste’” — now I will be filled from her destruction.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:18:2.hebrew: בארץ נכוחות יעול - את ירושלים יחריב. אמר יצחק להקב"ה: "יוחן רשע" — זה עשו. אמר לו הקדוש ברוך הוא: רשע הוא:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:18:2.english: In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully - He will destroy Jerusalem. Isaac said to the Holy One, Blessed be He: “Let favor be shown to the wicked” — this is Esau. The Holy One, Blessed be He, said to him: “He is wicked!”

Rashi on Megillah 6a:18:3.hebrew: אמר - יצחק: "בל למד צדק" — כלומר, אין אדם יכול ללמד עליו צדק:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:18:3.english: [He] said - Isaac [said]: “Yet will he not learn righteousness?” — that is to say, is no person able to plead merit on his behalf?

Rashi on Megillah 6a:18:4.english: He said to him - The Holy One, Blessed be He.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:18:5.hebrew: בארץ נכוחות יעול - את ירושלים יחריב. אמר יצחק להקב"ה: ״יוחן רשע״ — זה עשו; אמר לו הקדוש ברוך הוא: ״רשע הוא״:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:18:5.english: In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully - He will destroy Jerusalem. Isaac said to the Holy One, Blessed be He: “Let favor be shown to the wicked” — this is Esau; the Holy One, Blessed be He, said to him: “He is wicked.”

Rashi on Megillah 6a:18:6.hebrew: בארץ נכוחות יעול - כלומר, עתיד להחריב את ארץ ישראל:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:18:6.english: In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully - That is to say, he is destined to destroy the Land of Israel.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:18:7.hebrew: אמר יצחק - אם כן, בל יראה גאות ה':
Rashi on Megillah 6a:18:7.english: Isaac said - If so, “he will not behold the majesty of the Lord.”

Rashi on Megillah 6a:19:1.hebrew: זממו אל תפק - אל תוציאנו מנחיריו. זמם — כמין טבעת ברזל שנותנין בחוטמה של אנקה, ונמשכת בו, ומתוך חוזקה אינה משתמרת כי אם בו:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:19:1.english: Further not his evil device - Do not remove it [the muzzle] from his nostrils. A zamam is a kind of iron ring that they place in the nose of a she-camel, and she is led by it; and due to her strength, she cannot be restrained except by it.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:1:1.english: And it was found in accordance with my [opinion] - We read [this version].

Rashi on Megillah 6a:1:2.hebrew: רקתא דנהרא - שפת הנהר גבוה מן הנהר, אף ציפורי יושבת בראש ההר:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:1:2.english: The bank of a river - The bank of a river is higher than the river; so too, Tzippori sits at the top of the mountain.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:2:1.english: When a person dies here - When a great person dies in Babylonia.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:2:2.english: They lament him there - In Tiberias.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:2:3.english: Sheshakh - Babylonia, through the exchange of Atbash.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:2:4.english: And he had a name in Rakkath - He acquired renown in Tiberias.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:2:5.english: And when they bring up a casket - Of a deceased person from Babylonia to bury him in Tiberias.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:2:6.hebrew: אמרו הכי - הספדנין קורין בשווקים בלשון הזה, שיצאו לקראת המת:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:2:6.english: They said as follows - The eulogizers call out in the streets with this wording, that [the people] should go out to meet the deceased.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:2:7.english: Lovers of the remnants - Lovers of Israel.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:2:8.english: Residents of Rakkath, go out and receive the dead of the deep - The dead of low-lying Babylonia.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:3:1.hebrew: ר' זירא - עלה מבבל לארץ ישראל, ומת שם בטבריא:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:3:1.english: Rabbi Zeira - He ascended from Babylonia to the Land of Israel, and died there in Tiberias.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:3:2.english: The land of the deer - The Land of Israel.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:3:3.english: Raised her delights - [The delights] of Shinar.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:4:1.english: In its navel - In its center.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:6:1.hebrew: לא הוריש את יושבי קטרון - שבאה לחלקו, ועבר על מה שאמר הקב"ה: ״לא תחיה כל נשמה״ (דברים כ׳:ט״ז), והניחן לגור שם ביניהם ולהעלות להם מס:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:6:1.english: [Zebulun] did not drive out the inhabitants of Kitron - [This shows] that it fell into his portion; and he transgressed that which the Holy One, Blessed be He, said: “You shall not allow any soul to live” (Deuteronomy 20:16), and allowed them to dwell there among them and pay tribute to them.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:6:2.hebrew: על מדותיו - על מזלו, שנמדד לו מן השמים מדה שאינו חפץ בה:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:6:2.english: About his measures - About his lot, for there was measured out to him from Heaven a measure that he did not desire.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:7:1.english: All will need you - All your brothers will need you.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:7:2.hebrew: על ידי חלזון - חלזון עולה מן הים להרים, וצובעין בדמו תכלת, ונמכר בדמים יקרים:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:7:2.english: Due to the ḥilazon - The ḥilazon comes up from the sea to the mountains, and they dye tekhelet with its blood, and it is sold for a high price:

Rashi on Megillah 6a:7:3.hebrew: עמים הר יקראו - מכל השבטים יתקבצו להריך, לקנות שפוני טמוני חול:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:7:3.english: They shall call the peoples to the mountain - From all the tribes they will gather to your mountains to purchase the hidden treasures of the sand.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:8:1.hebrew: שפוני זה חלזון - שהוא דבר חשוב. ספון — חשוב בלשון ברייתא:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:8:1.english: “Treasures”; this is the ḥilazon - For it is an important thing; “safun” [means] “important” in the language of the Baraita.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:8:3.hebrew: זכוכית לבנה - היוצא מן החול, כדאמר ביציאות השבת (שבת טו:). וחול של זבולון חשוב משאר חולות, וראוי לזכוכית לבנה:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:8:3.english: White glass - Which comes from sand, as it says in [the chapter] Yetzi'ot HaShabbat (Shabbat 15b); and the sand of Zebulun is superior to other sands, and is suitable for white glass.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:8:4.hebrew: מי מודיעני - על זאת לתת לי דמים? כל המוצא חלזון ונוטלו בלא דמים — אינו מצליח:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:8:4.english: Who will inform me - [Who will inform me] about this, so that [they] give me payment? Anyone who finds a ḥilazon and takes it without payment will not succeed.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:8:5.hebrew: שם יזבחו זבחי צדק - כאשר אסור גזל בעולה, כך לא יגזלו ממך כלום; שאם יטול שוה פרוטה בלא דמים, תתקלקל הצביעה והחול, ולא יועיל כלום:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:8:5.english: “There they shall sacrifice offerings of righteousness” - Just as robbery is forbidden for a burnt-offering, so too, nothing will be robbed from you; for if [one] takes [even] the value of a peruta without payment, the dyeing and the sand will be ruined, and [he] will not profit at all.

Rashi on Megillah 6a:9:1.hebrew: זבת חלב ודבש - העזים אוכלין תאנים, והדבש נוטף מהן, והחלב זב מן העזים, ונעשים כמין נחל:
Rashi on Megillah 6a:9:1.english: Flowing with milk and honey - The goats eat figs, and honey drips from them, and milk flows from the goats, and they form a kind of stream.

Tosafot on Megillah 6a:14:1.hebrew: טראטריות וקרקסיאות - י"מ: בתי עבודת כוכבים, ומכנה אותן "טרטאכ'", לשון חרפה; וקרקסיאות — רוצה לומר: בית הכסא בלשון ערב. וקשה לומר שאותן מקומות מטונפות יכול ללמוד שם תורה! אלא ודאי לשממה יהא במהרה בימינו, ורוצה לומר: בתים שמתאספים שם לוועד של עובדי עבודת כוכבים:
Tosafot on Megillah 6a:14:1.english: "Theaters and circuses" - Some explain [these as] houses of idolatry, and [the Gemara] calls them "Tartakh" as a derogatory term; and kirkesayot means a privy in the Arabic language. But it is difficult to say that in those filthy places one would be able to study Torah! Rather, surely [they] shall be [turned] into desolation speedily in our days, and [the Gemara] means: houses where they gather for an assembly of idolaters.

Tosafot on Megillah 6a:4:1.english: "Because its appearance is good" - For there were gardens and orchards there.

Tosafot on Megillah 6a:8:1.hebrew: דכל הנוטל (פרוטה) ממך בלא דמים אין מועיל - דכתיב: "שם יזבחו זבחי צדק", וגזל לא מהני בזבח:
Tosafot on Megillah 6a:8:1.english: "That anyone who takes (a perutah) from you without payment will not prosper" - For it is written: "There they shall sacrifice offerings of righteousness," and stolen property is of no avail for a sacrifice.
